Messages.Author: reyda
Messages.Body:
"Orpheus" <orph...@wanadoo.fr> wrote in message
news:ae630c$8ci$1...@wanadoo.fr...

> "any damage the vampire inflicts one allies is reduced to 0".
>
> What about Oubliette : "and opposing minion burns one blood or life after
> combat" ?

burning life or blood is not damage. Therefore cards refering to those
effects aren't affected in any way by memories of mortality.

> And Theft of Vitae, is it considered as damage to an ally ?

no it's still a life/blood steal card. It doesn't deal damage to the
opposing ally. It works even under memories of mortality.

> Thanks,

de rien =)

Messages.Author: GreySeer
Messages.Body:
"Orpheus" <orph...@wanadoo.fr> wrote in message
news:ae630c$8ci$1...@wanadoo.fr...

> "any damage the vampire inflicts one allies is reduced to 0".
>
> What about Oubliette : "and opposing minion burns one blood or life after
> combat" ?
> And Theft of Vitae, is it considered as damage to an ally ?

I figured that Theft and Oubliette would work ( being that they're not
damage ) but I checked, and found on Google.

>>The vampire (with Memories of Mortality) will do 0 damage to the ally.
>>Does this include environmental damage (ie Weather Control, Carrion
Crows)?
>
>No.
>
>That's part of the definition of environmental damage, damage that isn't
>inflicted by the vampire. Weather Control, Carrion Crows, and damage from
>retainers will all damage the ally in combat with a vampire even when the
>vampire is afflicted with Memories of Mortality.
>
>Notice that a vampire could also successfully use Theft of Vitae, Call the
>Lamprey, or Tongue of the Serpent even though it had MoM as blood loss is
>not damage.
>
>
>Carpe noctem.
>
>Lasombra

>"any damage the vampire inflicts one allies is reduced to 0".

>What about Oubliette : "and opposing minion burns one blood or life after
>combat" ?

This is not damage, and so is unafffected by Memories of Mortality.

>And Theft of Vitae, is it considered as damage to an ally ?

Stealing life is not damage, and is unaffected by Memories of
Mortality.
